The '''Fomalhaut System''', also known as '''Alpha Piscis Austrini''', is located on the [[Rim Main]] within [[Dingir Subsector]] of the [[Solomani Rim Sector|Solomani Rim]]. 

== Description (Specifications) ==
Fomalhaut's primary ('''[[Fomalhaut (star)|Fomalhaut]] A''') is a blue-white main sequence star, with a yellow-orange main sequence companion star ('''[[Fomalhaut (star)|Fomalhaut]] B''', also known as '''TW Piscis Austrini''').  A second very far companion of spectral type M4 V, '''[[Fomalhaut (star)|Fomalhaut]] C''' (also known as '''LP 876-10''') is also associated with the system.  

* The system contains two gas giants as well as the the mainworld, [[Fomalhaut (SR 1024) (world)|Fomalhaut Prime]], and 10 other worlds -- including a captured rogue planet that revolves around the primary star in a highly eccentric orbit.
